description: Create a large-print emergency procedure reference sheet for someone with cognitive impairment. The document should include: (1) A title 'Emergency: Gas Leak Procedure' in large, bold font, (2) At least 5 numbered steps in 14pt+ font with clear single-action instructions, (3) At least 2 bold warnings containing 'DO NOT' or 'NEVER' or 'WARNING', (4) An emergency contact section with phone numbers. Keep the document to one page (under 800 words). Save the document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/gas_leak_procedure.docx (Ctrl+S).
